content.text: Regular waking at 2am isn't typical at 8, but it does happen, and it's often tied to a stretch of worry, a busy head, or a shifting routine. Tonight, try a calm 10-minute wind-down with no screens in the last hour before bed. Add a quick "worry chat" earlier in the evening so her head isn't doing it at 2am. If it keeps up for weeks, or she seems unwell or really distressed, mention it to her doctor.
